lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 7-8 vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible on the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gills, arranged in a grid-like pattern with 3-5 spots per column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a series of coordinate-like nodes across the mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from a high-luminance dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of approximately 4-6 small, high-luminance spots is visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily located towards the basal and leading edges.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density cluster of smaller, more uniform high-luminance spots that are notably more concentrated than the pattern on the primary lateral flank.
